August 25 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 127)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 25 across American and Latin American networks, Ted Fio Rito & Candy Candido on The Fitch Bandwagon, Harlow Wilcox delivering an urgent wartime salvage bulletin for the Office of War Information, country legend Eddy Arnold on The Howard Miller Show for Wrigley's Gum, Kalimán facing Mayan fire traps in Los Misterios de Bonampak (Capítulo 45), and Johnny Olsen hosting NBC's Second Chance (1940–1967):

War Production Board		 Harlow Wilcox (OWI Announcer) OWI Radio Bureau, War Ad Council ["Documentary", "Historical", "Public Affairs", "Educational", "World War II"] "An urgent wartime message from your Government's Office of War Information!" American homemakers are urged to pour every tablespoon of used kitchen frying grease into clean tin cans and bring them to local meat markets, explaining how waste fat produces vital glycerin needed to manufacture gunpowder, high-explosive artillery shells, and battlefield medicines.
